summary: More dellemc.openmanage changes: iDRAC10 support for user, virtual media and Redfish modules, OME 4.5 support for firmware modules, and new omevv modules for baseline profiles, compliance and firmware updates.
questions: How do I update firmware on a host or cluster with OMEVV in Ansible?
Do the redfish modules in dellemc.openmanage support iDRAC10?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage OME 4.5 and OMEVV modules
answer_card.answer_md:
- iDRAC10 support: `idrac_user` role, `idrac_user_info`, `idrac_virtual_media`, `redfish_event_subscription`, `redfish_firmware`, `redfish_power_state`.
- OME 4.5 support: `ome_firmware`, `ome_firmware_baseline`, `ome_firmware_baseline_compliance_info`, `ome_firmware_baseline_info`, `ome_firmware_catalog`.
- New OMEVV modules: `omevv_baseline_profile`, `omevv_baseline_profile_info`, `omevv_compliance_info`, and `omevv_firmware` (updates firmware of a single host or cluster).
